explanation: The deploy job failed because the GitHub Actions runner could not establish a TCP connection to the EC2 instance on port 22, which is a network/firewall issue rather than a code or workflow problem. The EC2 Security Group's inbound rules do not currently allow SSH (port 22) traffic from GitHub-hosted runner IP ranges, causing the SCP action to time out. The fix is to update the EC2 Security Group in AWS to allow inbound TCP/22 either from 0.0.0.0/0 (if SSH is otherwise locked down via key-based auth and used only for deploys) or, more precisely, from GitHub's published Actions IP ranges obtained via `curl https://api.github.com/meta | jq '.actions'`. No changes to the repository's workflow YAML or application source code are required.
